title: Cheap AI tokens are a grey market.
text: Resold credits and accounts can save up to 55%, but you may get a different model, pay more for cached tokens or have your prompts harvested. Use them only for work that isn't sensitive.

title: Agents need to know why, not just what.
text: Recording each architecture decision gives agents the reasons behind odd code. One team writes about one a day, and the agent now proposes most of them itself.

title: Write the spec before the code.
text: With a solid specification, the model works like a compiler from English to code.

title: One central agent beats a pile of workflows.
text: Workflows are fine for an MVP but break when a task is slightly different. One agent with many tools at the centre of the product is easier to maintain, and users who talk to it are more likely to pay.

title: Keep approvals and the source of truth in code.
text: Let the agent decide, but run user approvals and writes to critical data through deterministic code, and ship a new model only if it passes the evals.
